g.title: sync
g.text: Sync request vs remote completion | refactor candidate

g.title: cycle
g.text: AutoSync only: cycle lock -> index lock
disabled / busy / interval may return before cycle

g.title: lock
g.text: acquire index lock OR use caller-held lock

g.title: init
g.text: existing remote branch: fetch/checkout then index
new remote branch: local commit -> push -> index
failed new .git removed; existing entries retained

g.title: periodic
g.text: invoke cycle; save success / skipped / failed result

g.title: cycle->lock
g.text: own enabled / not degraded; pass held index lock

g.title: autoresult
g.text: other own failure / success / degraded skip -> continue

g.title: preflight
g.text: exact repo root, no active rebase, branch
all effective push URLs private; named credentials

g.title: refuse
g.text: input retained; scheduled marker not advanced
MCP write worker waits bounded 30s for busy

g.title: dirty
g.text: scheduled dirty refusal OR commit local changes

g.title: dry
g.text: no commit, inspect, reindex or push

g.title: pull
g.text: on conflict: abort and verify no active rebase

g.title: index
g.text: prewarm keys -> open DB -> per-source scan

g.title: unknown
g.text: recovery failure is distinct; inspect before retry

g.title: local
g.text: propagate failure; no push; owned locks released

g.title: done
g.text: manual return only; wrapper continues separately

g.title: cleanup
g.text: syncOwn finally: release only its owned locks
client cancellation does not cancel MCP sync

g.title: initend
g.text: initOwnSync has no index/repo lock acquisition
remove only newly created .git on failure; entries retained
remote push is not rolled back by later index failure

g.title: outerindex
g.text: AutoSync outer reindexAndMark (even after own failure)
then notice signature / backoff / state persistence
cycle/index locks still owned by wrapper

g.title: autofinal
g.text: AutoSync finally releases cycle + index locks
success / skipped / failure state is distinct from remote push

g.title: cyclefail
g.text: Outer reindex / notice / state throws: cycle_failed
prior successful push remains; persistence may itself fail
